question: Which part of our body do we mostly use to tap out a rhythm on the floor while dancing? 🦶
explanation: Super! We use our feet to tap, jump, and step to the beat of the music while dancing! 🦶
hint: You wear your shoes on them.

question: Which body part do we use to clap our hands to the music? 👏
explanation: Awesome! We bring our two hands together to make a loud clapping sound! 👏
hint: We have ten fingers on them.

question: How do we show a happy feeling in our dance? 😊
explanation: Great job! A big bright smile on our face shows everyone that we are very happy! 😊
hint: It happens on your face.

question: Which part of our body helps us look side to side gracefully? 👤
explanation: Fantastic! Our neck helps us move our head up, down, left, and right while dancing! 👤
hint: It connects your head to your body.

question: What do we do to make our body soft and bendy before dancing? 🧘
explanation: Super! Stretching helps our muscles wake up and get ready for safe dancing! 🧘
hint: We reach our arms up high.

question: What do we wear on our ankles to make a jingling sound in Indian dance? 🔔
explanation: Awesome! Ghungroos are special dancing bells we tie on our ankles to make sweet music! 🔔
hint: They have many tiny metal bells.

question: Which body part do we bend to make ourselves look very short? 🦵
explanation: Great job! Bending our knees helps us go down low to the floor! 🦵
hint: It is the middle part of your leg.

question: Which body part do we use to touch the bright blue sky? ✋
explanation: Fantastic! We stretch our long arms way up high to reach for the sky! ✋
hint: Your hands are at the end of them.

question: What should we do right before starting a fast dance? 🏃
explanation: Super! A warm-up gets our heart beating and our body fully ready to move! 🏃
hint: It means to do light exercises.

question: Which part of our face do we use to follow a moving hand in dance? 👀
explanation: Awesome! Our eyes are very important to show expression and look at our hand movements! 👀
hint: We use them to see.

question: What do we call special hand signs used in Indian classical dance? 🤌
explanation: Great job! Mudras are beautiful shapes we make with our fingers to tell a story! 🤌
hint: It starts with the letter M.

question: Which body part moves up and down when we take a deep breath? 🫁
explanation: Fantastic! Our chest rises and falls gently as we breathe in air while dancing! 🫁
hint: It is in the front of your body.

question: How should our back be when we stand in a proud dance posture? 🧍
explanation: Super! Keeping our back tall and straight makes our dance look beautiful and confident! 🧍
hint: Like a tall tree.

question: Which body part do we use to spin around in a circle? 🌀
explanation: Awesome! We use our whole body working together to spin gracefully like a top! 🌀
hint: It uses everything from head to toe.

question: What do we do to show respect at the very end of a dance? 🙏
explanation: Great job! We gently bow to say a big thank you to the lovely audience! 🙇
hint: We fold our hands in Namaste.

question: Which action uses our strong legs to leave the floor? 🦘
explanation: Fantastic! We push hard with our feet and legs to jump high into the air! 🦘
hint: Kangaroos do this very well.

question: What body part helps us twist our upper body side to side? 🔄
explanation: Super! Our waist is the middle part of our body that lets us twist and turn! 🔄
hint: We wear a belt here.

question: Which action uses our arms to look like a flying bird? 🦅
explanation: Awesome! We move our arms up and down nicely to pretend we are flying birds! 🦅
hint: Birds use their wings for this.

question: What do we call holding our body totally still in one pose? 🗽
explanation: Great job! Sometimes in dance, we freeze like a beautiful statue for a moment! 🗽
hint: They do not move at all.

question: Which part of our body hears the beat of the music? 🎵
explanation: Fantastic! Our ears listen very closely so we can dance right on the beat! 🎵
hint: We have one on each side of our head.

question: What body part do we use to wiggle and point during a dance? ☝️
explanation: Super! Our fingers can bend, wiggle, and point nicely to show different things! ☝️
hint: We have ten of them on our hands.

question: Which action makes a loud sound using our shoes? 👞
explanation: Awesome! Stomping our feet hard on the floor creates a very strong dance beat! 👞
hint: Elephants walk like this.

question: What do we move to say 'Yes' without speaking? 👤
explanation: Great job! Nodding our head up and down is a fun way to say 'yes' in a dance! 👤
hint: It sits on top of your neck.

question: Which body part do we roll around to loosen our arms? 🦾
explanation: Fantastic! Rolling our shoulders helps our arms feel very loose and relaxed! 🦾
hint: They attach your arms to your body.

question: What do we need to stand on only one foot? ⚖️
explanation: Super! Good balance helps us stand steady on one leg without falling over! ⚖️
hint: It keeps you from tumbling down.

question: Which body part do we bend to touch our toes? 🧘
explanation: Awesome! We bend nicely at our waist to reach all the way down to our toes! 🧘
hint: It is the middle of your body.

question: What action makes us move smoothly like a swimming fish? 🐟
explanation: Great job! Gliding our feet smoothly on the floor makes us look like we are floating! 🐟
hint: It is like slipping on ice.

question: Which body parts join together to make a Namaste shape? 🙏
explanation: Fantastic! We press our two flat palms together to make a beautiful Namaste sign! 🙏
hint: They are the flat parts of your hands.

question: What do we feel inside when we dance to fun music? 💖
explanation: Super! Dancing fills our body with lots of happy energy and excitement! ⚡
hint: It makes you want to move quickly.

question: Which body part is used to kick up high in the air? 🦵
explanation: Awesome! We swing our strong leg up high to do a fantastic dance kick! 🦵
hint: We use it to walk.

question: What action moves our body gently like a tree in the wind? 🌳
explanation: Great job! Swaying side to side smoothly makes us look like trees in a gentle breeze! 🌾
hint: It goes slowly side to side.

question: Which part of our arm bends to bring our hands to our shoulders? 💪
explanation: Fantastic! Our elbows act like little hinges that let our arms bend and fold! 💪
hint: It is the bumpy part in the middle of your arm.

question: How do we make our hands look like a blooming lotus flower? 🪷
explanation: Super! We open our fingers out wide to look like the beautiful petals of a flower! 🪷
hint: Spread your fingers apart.

question: Which body part touches the floor when we kneel down? 🦵
explanation: Awesome! Kneeling means gently resting our knees right on the floor! 🦵
hint: It is in the middle of the leg.

question: What do we hold in our hands to make a dance look prettier? ☂️
explanation: Great job! Props like sticks, scarves, or umbrellas make our dance stories extra fun! ☂️
hint: It is an object you carry.

question: What does a group need to dance nicely together? 🤝
explanation: Fantastic! When we practice good teamwork, everyone moves together beautifully! 🤝
hint: Working happily with friends.

question: Which action helps our ankles become strong for dancing? 🦶
explanation: Super! Rolling our ankles in little circles makes them very strong and ready to dance! 🦶
hint: Moving in a circle shape.

question: How do we move to show the crawling shape of a snake? 🐍
explanation: Awesome! A smooth, wavy wiggle makes our body look just like a slithering snake! 🐍
hint: It moves side to side on the ground.

question: Which part of the body connects our hands to our arms? ✋
explanation: Great job! Our wrists twist and turn to make our hand movements look magical! ✋
hint: You wear a watch here.

question: What action is like walking, but with very high knees? 🪖
explanation: Fantastic! Marching lifts our knees up high just like a brave soldier walking! 🪖
hint: Soldiers do this.

question: Which body part do we use to show surprise in our dance? 😲
explanation: Super! We can open our mouth into a big 'O' shape to look very surprised! 😲
hint: You use it to eat and talk.

question: What helps our legs move faster during a quick dance? 🏃
explanation: Awesome! Being flexible and bendy helps us move safely and quickly! 🤸
hint: It means you can stretch easily.

question: Which part of the foot touches the ground when we tiptoe? 🩰
explanation: Great job! We lift our heels and balance gently on our toes to walk very quietly! 🩰
hint: They are at the front of your foot.

question: How do we move our head to say 'No' to the music? 👤
explanation: Fantastic! Shaking our head from side to side shows a clear 'no' movement! ↔️
hint: Move left, then right.

question: Which body part can we cross in front of our chest? 🙅
explanation: Super! Crossing our arms making an 'X' shape is a very strong dance pose! 🙅
hint: They reach out from your shoulders.

question: What is the best way to practice our dance steps? 🔁
explanation: Awesome! Practicing our steps again and again makes us a perfect dancer! 🔁
hint: It means to repeat.

question: Which body part do we use to make a big circle in the air? ⭕
explanation: Great job! We can sweep our long arms all the way around to draw a giant circle! ⭕
hint: They have hands at the end.

question: What do we do to cool down our body after a long dance? 🌬️
explanation: Fantastic! Slow breathing helps our tired body calm down and rest safely! 🌬️
hint: It fills your lungs with air.

question: How do we make our hands look like twinkling stars? ✨
explanation: Super! Opening and closing our fingers really fast looks like shining little stars! ✨
hint: Move your fingers fast.

question: Who should we always smile at while performing our dance? 😊
explanation: Awesome! We share our beautiful smile with the lovely audience watching us dance! 😊
hint: The people watching you.
